history.author: Appsara
history.description: Initial version created based on the confirmed screen designs

purpose: This document explains the purpose of EMS's Voyage Update details. This feature allows the user to update Load voyage, TSP voyage and Discharge voyage for the selected BL.
features: Selected PR&Ds Booking should be in Pre Entered and Entered status.

events.description: Opens the Voyage Update screen with the selected bookings.
events.triggered_when: User selects one or more bookings using the check boxes, clicks the Menu icon near Cross Booking Depot Activity and clicks Voyage Update.

events.description: Selects all bookings under the route group (select all check box) or a single booking (individual check box) for the voyage update.
events.triggered_when: User clicks the select all check box or an individual booking check box in the Voyage Update screen.

events.description: Validates the changes made in Update Routing for the selected bookings and shows the result grid.
events.triggered_when: User clicks Validate after selecting bookings and filling one or more fields in Update Routing.

events.description: Processes the validated changes for the selected bookings and shows the result grid. On closing the result grid the changes are applied to the data.
events.triggered_when: User clicks Process after validating the changes.
